Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Record Class LimelightFrame

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.LimelightFrame
Record Components:
hasTarget - equivalent to tv != 0.
tx - horizontal offset to the crosshair in degrees, positive to the right (Limelight convention; PhotonVision uses positive to the left).
ty - vertical offset to the crosshair in degrees, positive upwards.
txnc - horizontal offset from the principal point, in degrees.
tync - vertical offset from the principal point, in degrees.
ta - target area as a percentage of the image (0-100).
ts - target skew/rotation in degrees.
tid - id of the primary AprilTag, or -1 if there is no target.
pipelineLatencyMs - latency attributed to the pipeline (key tl).
captureLatencyMs - latency attributed to the capture (key cl).
captureTimestampSeconds - the frame's capture instant, in the FPGA time base.
targetCount - number of visible fiducials after applying the id filters.
fiducials - per-visible-tag detail, in the order rawfiducials publishes.
megaTag1Pose - robot pose estimated without an external heading (the MegaTag1 equivalent), in the blue-origin field frame.
megaTag2Pose - robot pose estimated by pinning the heading the robot code wrote to robot_orientation_set (the MegaTag2 equivalent).
tagSpanMeters - maximum distance between the tags used for the estimate.
avgTagDistMeters - average camera-to-tag distance of the tags used.
avgTagAreaPercent - average area of the tags used, as a percentage of the image.
cameraToTarget - camera -> primary tag transform, in the WPILib convention.
robotToTarget - robot -> primary tag transform, in the WPILib convention.
targetPixelMetrics - pixel metrics of the primary target, for the t2d key.
cornersXY - detected corners in pixels, flattened as [x0,y0,x1,y1,...].
public record LimelightFrame(boolean hasTarget, double tx, double ty, double txnc, double tync, double ta, double ts, int tid, double pipelineLatencyMs, double captureLatencyMs, double captureTimestampSeconds, int targetCount, LimelightFrame.RawFiducial[] fiducials, Optional<edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose3d> megaTag1Pose, Optional<edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose3d> megaTag2Pose, double tagSpanMeters, double avgTagDistMeters, double avgTagAreaPercent, Optional<edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Transform3d> cameraToTarget, Optional<edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Transform3d> robotToTarget, LimelightFrame.PixelMetrics targetPixelMetrics, double[] cornersXY) extends Record
An immutable snapshot of one simulated-camera cycle, already translated into the semantics of a real Limelight (degrees, percentages, sign conventions).

This is the feature's internal currency: the LimelightTargetTranslator produces it from a PhotonPipelineResult, and both LimelightNTPublisher and LimelightSimDevice consume it. Keeping a single frame per cycle guarantees NetworkTables and the SimDevice never fall out of sync.

    • empty

      public static LimelightFrame empty(double pipelineLatencyMs, double captureLatencyMs, double captureTimestampSeconds)
      A frame with no detections, carrying the current cycle's latency and timestamp. A real Limelight keeps publishing at its FPS even when it sees nothing, so this is what gets published when the pipeline returns zero targets.
      Parameters:
      pipelineLatencyMs - pipeline latency in milliseconds.
      captureLatencyMs - capture latency in milliseconds.
      captureTimestampSeconds - capture timestamp in FPGA seconds.
      Returns:
      an empty but temporally coherent frame.
